name: Sayounara, Enkou Musume-san.
original_name: さようなら、援交娘さん。
source:
She was okay going bareback.

A proper prostitute wouldn't do that.
She was just throwing herself away.

Goodbye, girl who I fucked to throw away my virginity.

A soiled earth bears rotten fruit.

She was broken from the start.
I rented her broken, and I returned her that way.

An adult visual novel with rather sad undertones. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE162939.html]DLsite English[/url]]
